description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was only obtainable for 24hrs from the "Once a year sale" bundle for Black Friday.
The paint was available to purchase on Black Friday 2021 from November 26th-29th 2021 for 19,990 tankoins. It was part of a special bundle "Morion" which also contained 300 ultra containers.
This paint was also available during Black Friday 2022: The "Black Entity" shop bundle had this paint, 75 Ultra Containers, and one Nuclear Energy supply, for the Price of 5990 Tankoins

Interesting facts

This paint was only obtainable for 24hrs from the "Once a year sale" bundle for Black Friday.
